test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man takes 6 hours to go to a place and come back by walking both the ways. He could have saved 2 hours by riding both the ways. The distance covered in the whole journey is 20 miles. What is the average speed for the whole journey if he goes by walking and comes back by riding?
solution:
**Given**

Total time by walking both ways = 6 hours

Time saved by riding both ways = 2 hours

Total distance = 20 miles

**Concept:**

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

**Solution:**

Time has taken on walking both ways at constant speed = 6 hrs

Time has taken on walking one way at constant speed = 6
